rest.speaker: Ren
rest.text: A new day. Let's take it one step at a time.

stay.speaker: Ren
stay.text: There's still a little more to do.

look.speaker: Ren
look.text: Two chairs, two cups. A small place that feels like home.

look.speaker: Ren
look.text: Everything we need for a simple breakfast. The bread and apple are on the counter.

look.speaker: Ren
look.text: The village can wait. Only our home is open in this foundation build.
